description: Take a quick arcade break with Dino Run+. Open the game inside ChatGPT, choose your dinosaur, and jump over obstacles using Space, Up, W, or a tap. Press again in the air to double jump. Collect coins, unlock six dinosaur skins, discover seasonal scenery and day/night transitions, and challenge your personal best. Pause and retry with simple controls. No separate account or payment is required. Progress is saved locally when your browser or ChatGPT sandbox allows storage; it is not synced across devices. Coins are earned in the game and have no real-money value.

defaultPrompt: I want a quick dinosaur jumping game
